annotations.title: Base wallet, token and gas lookup

description: Base (chain 8453) on-chain lookup for AI agents: wallet ETH balance and ERC-20 token balances (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, USDbC, EURC, DAI, cbETH, AERO plus up to 10 custom tokens), nonce and contract check; resolve a Basename (name.base.eth) to an address and the wallet's primary Basename; ERC-20 token info (name, symbol, decimals, total supply); latest block, base fee, gas price and transfer cost estimate. Read-only public RPC data. Price: 0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tokens.description: Extra ERC-20 token addresses for the wallet balances

name: base_lookup
